transitions.action: latchedRecipeIn := recipeIn; requestType := ADD; clear one-scan success pulses, error, and status defaults

transitions.condition: rising(deleteRecipe) AND no other request rising
transitions.action: latchedRecipeIn := recipeIn; requestType := DELETE; clear one-scan success pulses, error, and status defaults

transitions.condition: rising(modifyRecipe) AND no other request rising
transitions.action: latchedRecipeIn := recipeIn; requestType := MODIFY; clear one-scan success pulses, error, and status defaults

transitions.condition: rising(queryRecipe) AND no other request rising
transitions.action: latchedRecipeIn := recipeIn; requestType := QUERY; clear one-scan success pulses, error, and status defaults
no database mutation; invalidRequest diagnostic; simultaneous rising edges are outside the valid domain

transitions.action: reject; no database mutation; invalid ID diagnostic; normal domain excludes recipeID 0 for add
error := TRUE; status := 16#8002; no database mutation
error := TRUE; status := 16#8003; no database mutation

transitions.condition: latchedRecipeIn.recipeID nonzero, absent, and an empty slot exists
transitions.action: i := lowest index with recipe[i].recipeID = 0; recipe[i] := latchedRecipeIn; recipeAdded := TRUE; error := FALSE; status := 0
error := TRUE; status := 16#8004; no database mutation
matching slot recipeID := 0; other fields remain unchanged/unconstrained; recipeDeleted := TRUE; error := FALSE; status := 0
error := TRUE; status := 16#8005; no database mutation

error := TRUE; status := 16#8001; no database mutation

timer_plan.reset_conditions: No IEC timer FBs are required. Requests are handled by rising-edge detection. Success outputs are one-scan pulses; error and status clear combinationally on idle.

priorities: Reject invalid/multiple simultaneous rising requests before any database access or mutation.
On any error, preserve the recipe database exactly as sampled before the scan.
For add: duplicate-ID check has priority over database-full check.
For add: a nonzero recipeID is required; recipeID=0 denotes an empty slot and is rejected for add in the normal valid domain.
For add success: insert into the lowest-index empty slot, preserving uniqueness and all other slots.
For delete/modify/query: use the pre-scan database snapshot for search and target selection.
Only one accepted operation may execute per scan; at most one rising request is valid per invocation.
Success indicators are one-scan pulses; error=false and status=0 on successful or idle scans.
Compare REAL fields using absolute tolerance 1e-5.
The caller-owned recipe array persists across scans and must not be reinitialized per scan.

initial_values.recipe: caller-owned ARRAY[1..10] OF ST_Recipe; initial slots all have recipeID=0, ingredientType=0, ingredientRatio=0.0, productionTemperature=0.0; not reinitialized per scan

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
actions: Sample addRecipe, deleteRecipe, modifyRecipe, queryRecipe, and recipeIn at invocation.
Compute riseAdd, riseDelete, riseModify, riseQuery from current inputs versus retained previous-input booleans.
Latch recipeIn only when a single valid rising operation is selected.
Update retained previous-input booleans after edge computation for the next scan.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority & state transitions
actions: Set default internal result registers: no success pulses, error=false, status=0, no database mutation.
Detect invalid multiple rising requests; if present, enter INVALID and skip all database mutation.
Otherwise execute the single accepted state transition using the pre-scan recipe snapshot.
For add, evaluate recipeID validity, duplicate check, then full check, then commit to lowest empty slot.
For delete/modify/query, search the pre-scan snapshot and commit only if validation succeeds.
On any validation failure, set the specified error/status and preserve all recipe records.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
actions: No IEC timer function blocks are used in this architecture; this stage is intentionally empty.
If timers are added later, call every timer FB unconditionally at top level outside CASE/IF and only use their outputs in stage 2/4.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
actions: Assign recipe IN_OUT only through the stage-2 atomic commit path; do not write outputs inside CASE/IF branches.

formal_assertions.formula: G((error = TRUE) -> (status = 16#8001 OR status = 16#8002 OR status = 16#8003 OR status = 16#8004 OR status = 16#8005))
G((recipeAdded = TRUE) -> (error = FALSE AND status = 16#0000 AND recipeIn.recipeID /= 0))
G(forall i,j in 1..10: ((i < j AND recipe[i].recipeID /= 0 AND recipe[j].recipeID /= 0) -> recipe[i].recipeID /= recipe[j].recipeID))

G((recipeAdded = TRUE) -> (exists i in 1..10: recipe[i].recipeID = recipeIn.recipeID AND recipe[i].ingredientType = recipeIn.ingredientType AND abs(recipe[i].ingredientRatio - recipeIn.ingredientRatio) <= 1e-5 AND abs(recipe[i].productionTemperature - recipeIn.productionTemperature) <= 1e-5))

G((recipeModified = TRUE) -> (exists i in 1..10: recipe[i].recipeID = recipeIn.recipeID AND recipe[i].ingredientType = recipeIn.ingredientType AND abs(recipe[i].ingredientRatio - recipeIn.ingredientRatio) <= 1e-5 AND abs(recipe[i].productionTemperature - recipeIn.productionTemperature) <= 1e-5))
G((recipeDeleted = TRUE) -> (forall i in 1..10: recipe[i].recipeID /= recipeIn.recipeID))

G((addRecipe = FALSE AND deleteRecipe = FALSE AND modifyRecipe = FALSE AND queryRecipe = FALSE) -> (recipeAdded = FALSE AND recipeDeleted = FALSE AND recipeModified = FALSE AND error = FALSE AND status = 16#0000))
